task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL in the format 's3://bucket-name.region.amazonaws.com'. The function should return the region name.
Create a JSON policy document for an IAM role that allows an EC2 instance to read objects from a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regex pattern that matches valid AWS IAM role ARNs in the format 'arn:aws:iam::account-id:role/role-name'. The pattern should validate the structure and account ID format.
